ceo.headline: A vision. A legacy. A commitment.
ceo.quote: At 2HNOUR SARL, we are deeply convinced that every infrastructure represents far more than a simple assembly of materials: IT EMBODIES A VISION, CARRIES AN AMBITION AND PAVES THE WAY FOR SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT. Building is a responsibility. Preserving and transmitting it is our commitment. This is how we build, today, the legacy of tomorrow.

about.meta_desc: Our history, vision and values — Excellence, Integrity, Responsibility, Safety, Sustainability.
about.hero_title: A signature of excellence for Cameroonian construction.
about.hero_subtitle: Since our founding, 2HNOUR SARL has supported public institutions and private players in construction, rehabilitation and preservation of their built heritage.
about.history_headline: Building with conviction. Serving with consistency.
about.history_p1: Founded in Yaoundé, 2HNOUR SARL has established itself as a reference partner for public administrations, institutions and private players seeking integrated BTP expertise.
about.history_p2: Under the leadership of CEO Mme Virginie Hanna FADIMATOU, our company brings together engineers, technicians and craftsmen around a shared standard: delivering durable, aesthetic and perfectly maintained structures.
about.history_p3: We believe that a well-designed and well-maintained infrastructure is a lever for development — for its users, for the nation and for the environment.
about.vision_headline: Building the future with clarity and determination.
about.vision_lead: Our vision and mission guide every decision and every project to build modern, durable and high-impact infrastructure for Cameroon.
about.vision_title: Become the reference for integrated BTP in Central Africa.
about.vision_text: We aim to uphold the highest standards of construction, maintenance and heritage management, cultivating the pride of work well done and transmitted.
about.mission_title: Offer a complete, coherent and responsible service.
about.mission_text: From design to maintenance, we support every project with unwavering commitment to quality, safety, ethics and environmental respect.

batir.title: Build — Construction & New Structures
batir.description: We design and build structures to the highest standards of quality, safety and performance. From structural work to turnkey delivery, we ensure strict compliance with technical standards, contract deadlines and client requirements.

panels.label: Methodology & Process
panels.text: Soil testing and structural modeling, rigorous selection of certified materials, site organization complying with HSE standards, weekly milestone tracking and joint acceptance at each key stage.

panels.label: Standards & Compliance
panels.text: Adherence to DTU standards, local seismic regulations, the most demanding institutional specifications and firm commitment to contractual schedules.

panels.label: Target Projects
panels.text: Ministry headquarters, embassies and consulates, universities and technical colleges, clinics and district hospitals, logistics warehouses and industrial zones.

panels.label: Equipment Fleet
panels.text: Heavy earthmoving machinery, tower cranes and mobile cranes, industrial concrete mixers, metal formwork systems and state-of-the-art compaction equipment.

equiper.title: Equip — Fitting-out, Finishes & Equipment
equiper.description: We transform bare spaces into functional and aesthetic environments of prestige. Meticulous finishes, integrated technical equipment and outdoor landscaping: every detail is designed to enhance your infrastructure.
features: Wall and floor coverings (tiles, hardwood, carpet)
Creation of landscaped areas & garden design

panels.label: Methodology & Process
panels.text: Aesthetic kickoff meeting with the client, presentation of material palettes and color charts, coordination of trade contractors in optimized sequence to minimize delays and avoid interference.

panels.label: Standards & Quality
panels.text: Materials certified to ISO and local Cameroonian standards, finishes compliant with DTU guidelines, ten-year warranty on secondary works and post-completion service included.

panels.label: Target Projects
panels.text: Interior renovation of official palaces, fitting-out of conference rooms and reception halls, creation of institutional gardens and landscaped parks, decoration of hotel complexes and state residences.

panels.label: Green Spaces & Landscape
panels.text: Selection of plants suited to local microclimates, automated irrigation networks, eco-responsible water management and zero toxic phytosanitary products in public areas.

entretenir.title: Maintain — Facility Management & Hygiene
entretenir.description: We ensure the longevity and operational continuity of your buildings through an integrated maintenance, hygiene and sanitation service. Preventive maintenance, professional cleaning and pest control: a single point of contact for all your needs.
features: Glass, facade and delicate surface washing

panels.label: Methodology & Process
panels.text: Initial audit of facility conditions, development of a predictive maintenance schedule, operations scheduled outside business hours and intervention reports delivered within 24 hours.

panels.label: Hygiene & Safety Standards
panels.text: Protocols aligned with WHO guidelines and Cameroonian hygiene regulations, approved non-toxic products, certified personal protective equipment and full 3D traceability.

panels.label: Target Projects
panels.text: Ministry buildings and corporate headquarters, hotels and hospital complexes, university campuses, logistics hubs and industrial sites, official and diplomatic residences.

panels.label: Contracts & Monitoring
panels.text: Turnkey annual maintenance contracts, on-call emergency response, client dashboard for real-time tracking and quarterly review meetings.

renover.title: Renovate — Rehabilitation & Asset Valorization
renover.description: We intervene on existing structures to enhance their functionality, aesthetics and durability. Comprehensive rehabilitation or targeted renovation: we reduce aging costs and optimize the asset value of your properties.
features: Compliance upgrades and energy efficiency improvements

panels.label: Diagnosis & Audit
panels.text: Visual and instrumented inspections, structural pathology diagnosis (cracks, moisture, material degradation), technical audit report provided within 5 business days with costed recommendations.

panels.label: Standards & Compliance
panels.text: Application of seismic codes, accessibility and fire safety compliance, architectural preservation adherence and certified structural engineer oversight.

panels.label: Target Projects
panels.text: Rehabilitation of aging public buildings, degraded facade refurbishment, reinforcement of compromised structures, conversion of office spaces into modern layouts, residential building upgrades.

panels.label: Efficiency & Performance
panels.text: Installation of thermal and acoustic insulation adapted to the Cameroonian climate, replacement of joinery with high-efficiency glazing and optimization of lighting and HVAC systems.

sengager.title: Commit — Asset Management & Sustainable Development
sengager.description: Beyond job sites, we stand by your side over the long term: strategic advice for asset valuation, heritage audits, active CSR policies and joint-venture partnerships to build tomorrow's legacy together.

panels.label: Consulting & Heritage Strategy
panels.text: Built asset condition audit, life-cycle cost modeling (LCC), prioritized recommendations and support with multi-year capital investment planning.

panels.label: CSR & Sustainable Development
panels.text: Strong environmental commitment: construction waste reduction, low-carbon materials, continuous staff training on HSE best practices and annual CSR reporting.

panels.label: Partnerships & Joint Ventures
panels.text: 2HNOUR SARL establishes itself as a reliable partner for BTP majors, public institutions and key accounts. We operate in specialized subcontracting or joint ventures bringing certified capabilities.

panels.label: Compliance & Governance
panels.text: Strict adherence to public and private procurement regulations, transparent governance, full alignment with top-tier requirements and guaranteed on-time delivery.

solidarity_page.meta_desc: Discover 2HNOUR SARL's civic commitment: solidarity projects, education support, hygiene 3D and emergency aid in Cameroon.
solidarity_page.hero_title: Building a More Human Future: Our Solidarity Commitment
solidarity_page.hero_subtitle: Beyond stones and infrastructure, 2HNOUR SARL puts its BTP expertise and resources at the service of vulnerable communities and social progress.
solidarity_page.pillars_subtitle: A structured approach to turn our technical expertise into a lever of dignity and fulfillment for local populations.

pillars.p1_desc: Free provision of our BTP know-how to rehabilitate orphanages, rural schools, healthcare centers and dilapidated community spaces.
pillars.p2_desc: Regular distribution of school kits, IT equipment and ergonomic furniture to provide children with better learning conditions.
pillars.p3_title: Hygiene, Sanitation & Clean Water Access (3D Action)
pillars.p3_desc: Free disinfection and pest control campaigns in schools and local markets, paired with the installation of safe drinking water points.
pillars.p4_desc: Distribution of food supplies, hygiene kits and emergency material relief during critical periods or to communities in extreme vulnerability.

solidarity_page.projects_subtitle: Join us to amplify the impact. 2HNOUR funds supervision, technical teams and logistics.

projects.p1_title: Complete Rehabilitation of the Refectory and Sanitary Facilities at Yaoundé Orphanage
projects.p1_objective: Full overhaul of roof, tiling, plumbing and painting for a dormitory sheltering 45 children.
projects.p1_support: 100% coverage of skilled labor and 50% of building materials.
projects.p2_title: 3D Campaign & Installation of a Drinking Water Borehole at Mbankomo Public School
projects.p2_objective: Full vector disinfection and connection of a clean water borehole for 320 pupils.
projects.p2_support: Full coverage of 3D treatment teams and hydrogeological surveys.
projects.p3_title: Distribution of 500 School Kits & Ergonomic Class Furniture
projects.p3_objective: Provision of student desks, benches, school bags and textbooks for 3 primary schools lacking equipment.
projects.p3_support: Direct funding of supplies and transportation logistics.

solidarity_page.transparency_desc: All external contributions collected (financial or in-kind) are fully allocated to field actions. 2HNOUR SARL absorbs all administrative, management and transport costs as well as the compensation of deployed technical crews.
